senses.label: c

senses.gloss: to become reduced. Sifra l. c. (ref. to שחפת, v. supra) יש לך אדם … שהוא נ׳ (not וכי יש) sometimes a person is sick in bed, yet his flesh is preserved: therefore the text says, ‘and consumption’, which means that he is wasting away; Yalk. Lev. l. c.
